# The Reverse Emo Changeling

> Independent, non-commercial bilingual social-artistic magazine and e-zine (PL/EN) published by Toxic Echo Studio. Registered periodical (SO w Krakowie I Ns Rej PR 3553). system_version: 1.11.0, last_updated: 2026-11-19.

## Technical Overview
- Brand: The Reverse Emo Changeling
- system_version: 1.11.0
- last_updated: 2026-11-19
- Architecture: Static bilingual HTML5/CSS3 documents for Polish (/pl/) and English (/en/)
- Scripts: None on editorial pages (pure HTML5/CSS3 navigation and layout)
- Privacy: No cookies and no sessionStorage
- Publisher: Bartosz Gala - Toxic Echo Studio (https://toxic-echo.studio/)
- Lead Journalist: Nico "Zebroid" Łach
- Editor-in-Chief: Mighn Taghor
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-ND 4.0)
